Python

from frameio_experimental import FrameioExperimental, AccountRoleData

client = FrameioExperimental(
    token="YOUR_TOKEN_HERE",
)

    account_id="63aae2e5-b376-4ec3-bae6-ed6f635fad72",

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://api.frame.io/v4/accounts/63aae2e5-b376-4ec3-bae6-ed6f635fad72/users/312d7d3a-b284-4d9f-aef0-1f60a19ea87b"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"data\": {\n    \"role\": \"admin\"\n  }\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("PATCH", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.frame.io/v4/accounts/78a09d26-dbcd-4a77-9ea2-167a991da7f6/files/1cc5d214-c463-40b3-8be0-747afae534ea/comments")! as URL,
